string-array.name: chat_quick_messages
string-array.item: I’m feeling really uneasy walking right now and would love to stay on the phone with you until I get where I’m going.
I think someone is following me. Please stay with me and keep an eye on my location.
Please call me right now. I’d feel safer talking to someone.
I’m on my way. Please check on me in 15 minutes.
I need a ride. Can someone please come and pick me up?
I’m lost and need help finding my way.
My phone battery is low. Please call me soon, while I still have power.
I need help right now. Please come to me or call 999.
I’ve reached safely. Thank you for staying with me!
